sample_unit: standardized geriatric vignettes (each rated by 5 geriatricians)

links.outcome: Completeness and guideline alignment of ChatGPT clinical responses to geriatric vignettes, including omissions
links.effect: Completeness 55/70, accuracy 59/70, guideline alignment 61/70; reviewers identified key omissions such as missing assessments or guideline-recommended tools in multiple vignettes; urinary incontinence scored lowest.
links.quote: Reviewers identified key omissions, such as missing assessments or guideline-recommended tools, in multiple vignettes.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's responses to standardized geriatric clinical vignettes across accuracy, completeness, and safety domains without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
